title: Quit the Gym, Do Calisthenics (especially if you're skinny)

chapters.title: The One Thing The Gym Does Better

description:
Not medical advice: we're not doctors or trainers. Under 18? Keep efforts moderate. Stop if anything hurts.

REP THEORY 90, the full 90-day plan written out week by week 
(every week, every set, every hold + a 90-day tracker): https://thereptheory.gumroad.com/l/rt90


Drop down and do as many push-ups as you can. Keep that number, because at the end of this video you'll find out what it says about you. Then we rank 5 reasons skinny guys should quit the gym and train with their own body, and #1 isn't about money. It's the advantage being light gives you on a bar. Plus the one thing the gym honestly does better, and how to fix it without one.

What you'll learn:
• The push-up test, and what a 10-year study of 1,104 men linked it to
• #5 Free, and it never closes (chair dips to start)
• #4 Push-ups build your chest as well as a bench press
• #3 Calisthenics builds the shape, not just the size
• #2 Light weights build muscle too
• #1 Being skinny is your advantage on a bar
• The one thing the gym does better (legs), and the no-gym fix
• A 3-day full-body plan and how to read your push-up test
